import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# Operation History:
# 1) JOIN Source6_36_0 and Source6_36_1 on "Id"
join_01 = pd.merge(
    source0.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x"}),
    source1.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y"}),
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# 2) JOIN Source6_36_2 and Source6_36_3 on "Id"
join_23 = pd.merge(
    source2.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x_3"}),
    source3.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y_4"}),
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# 3) JOIN Source6_36_4 and Source6_36_5 on "Id"
join_45 = pd.merge(
    source4.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x_5"}),
    source5.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y_6"}),
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# 4) JOIN Source6_36_6 and Source6_36_7 on "Id"
join_67 = pd.merge(
    source6.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_x_7"}),
    source7.rename(columns={"SalePrice": "SalePrice_y_8"}),
    on="Id",
    how="inner"
)

# Now join all four intermediate joins on "Id" to form the final target table
temp = pd.merge(join_01, join_23, on="Id", how="inner")
temp2 = pd.merge(join_45, join_67, on="Id", how="inner")
target = pd.merge(temp, temp2, on="Id", how="inner")

# Ensure the target columns are exactly as specified in the target schema and order:
target = target[
    [
        "Id",
        "SalePrice_x",
        "SalePrice_y",
        "SalePrice_x_3",
        "SalePrice_y_4",
        "SalePrice_x_5",
        "SalePrice_y_6",
        "SalePrice_x_7",
        "SalePrice_y_8",
    ]
]

# Cast columns to the correct types as per target schema
target = target.astype({
    "Id": "int64",
    "SalePrice_x": "float64",
    "SalePrice_y": "float64",
    "SalePrice_x_3": "float64",
    "SalePrice_y_4": "float64",
    "SalePrice_x_5": "float64",
    "SalePrice_y_6": "float64",
    "SalePrice_x_7": "float64",
    "SalePrice_y_8": "float64",
})

# Write the result to the specified path
target.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0
src0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
src1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
src2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
src3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
src4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
src5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
src6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
src7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/training_7.csv", index_col=0)

# Add a source identifier column to each to distinguish SalePrice columns after pivot
src0['source'] = 'SalePrice_x'
src1['source'] = 'SalePrice_y'
src2['source'] = 'SalePrice_x_3'
src3['source'] = 'SalePrice_y_4'
src4['source'] = 'SalePrice_x_5'
src5['source'] = 'SalePrice_y_6'
src6['source'] = 'SalePrice_x_7'
src7['source'] = 'SalePrice_y_8'

# UNION all sources vertically
df_all = pd.concat([src0, src1, src2, src3, src4, src5, src6, src7], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY Id and source, aggregate SalePrice by mean (in case of duplicates)
df_grouped = df_all.groupby(['Id', 'source'], as_index=False).agg({'SalePrice':'mean'})

# Pivot so each source becomes a column
df_pivot = df_grouped.pivot(index='Id', columns='source', values='SalePrice')

# Reset index to bring Id back as a column
df_pivot.reset_index(inplace=True)

# Reorder columns exactly as target schema
target_columns = ['Id', 'SalePrice_x', 'SalePrice_y', 'SalePrice_x_3', 'SalePrice_y_4', 
                  'SalePrice_x_5', 'SalePrice_y_6', 'SalePrice_x_7', 'SalePrice_y_8']

# Some columns might be missing if no data, fill with NaN
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_pivot.columns:
        df_pivot[col] = pd.NA

df_final = df_pivot[target_columns]

# Write to target CSV
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_36/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
